metadata.title: Intrathecal methotrexate for GTN
metadata.indication: Prevention of central nervous system involvement in high-risk GTN or low-risk GTN with lung metastases.

indications.description: CNS prophylaxis in low-risk GTN with lung metastases.

treatment.schedule_summary: The specialist team gives methotrexate into the fluid around the spinal cord. There are three treatments two weeks apart. The team coordinates appointments with your systemic chemotherapy. Take the single prescribed oral folinic acid tablet 24 hours after the spinal dose. If you also have a separate methotrexate course, ask the team to write down both rescue schedules. Call immediately about a missed or vomited tablet.
